content.rendered: The Internet is pretty volatile. As new information become available, the old one disappears. Sometimes we have to look back and see what’s happened in the past years. Shall you be interested in seeing how ntop changed in the past twelve years, you can have a look at this URL, that has several snapshots of the ntop web site.
